subject: Portal crosswalk preflight + upload window for Vendr → OneTrust bridge
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmecloud.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@bridgeops.io>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr → OneTrust bridge: preflight & upload window

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We're ramping toward a partner migration that requires us to push ~3k proof artifacts from our Vendr profile into a OneTrust collection. Before we request our security team to sign off, we need to confirm:

- A short preflight checklist we can run (field mapping + minimal proofs)
- A presigned-upload window for a canary (S3 presign or direct OneTrust upload)
- How you want the CAIQ/SIG mapping represented (CSV vs. OneTrust fields)

I attached a rough Vendr manifest (acme_vendr_manifest_v1.csv) and a first-draft checklist. Can we aim for a canary upload next week? Our compliance lead Tom Rivers is looped in.

Attachments: acme_vendr_manifest_v1.csv, preflight-checklist.md

Best,
Alice
Security Programs / AcmeCloud

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr → OneTrust bridge: preflight & upload window

Hi Alice — thanks for the manifest and draft checklist. Looping in Jonas for the field/API details and Marissa to own the evidence governance side.

Proposed plan (short):
1) Field crosswalk: Jonas to map Vendr CSV columns → OneTrust claim fields and mark required minimal proofs (SOC2 sections, CAIQ pointers).
2) Canary window: we can open a 3-hour presigned S3 upload window on Wed 2028-03-29 14:00–17:00 PT for an initial 50-artifact canary. If that works we’ll extend in a second window to move the remainder.
3) Smoke test: Jonas will validate ingestion and Marissa will confirm proof possession and retention tags.
4) Attestation: If successful, we’ll provide a short attestation form for AcmeCloud to sign (DocuSign link to follow).

Please confirm the canary slot above or propose alternatives. I attached our internal S3 presign policy for reference (s3-presign-policy.pdf).

Action items:
- Alice: confirm canary window or propose another slot (reply)
- Jonas: start mapping and return a CSV crosswalk by EOD Tue 2028-03-28
- Marissa: review retention tags and minimal-proof bucketization

Thanks — Neha
Director, Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
[attachment: s3-presign-policy.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr → OneTrust bridge: preflight & upload window

On Mon, Mar 27, 2028 at 10:03 AM Neha Kapoor wrote:
> Looping in Jonas for the field/API details...

Thanks — I dug into the manifest. High level notes:
- Vendr CSV has columns: vendor_id, question_slug, answer_text, evidence_url, evidence_hash, uploaded_at
- OneTrust expects structured claims: control_id, narrative, attachments[], evidence_type, jurisdiction, retention_tag

Mapping approach (quick):
- control_id <= question_slug (CAIQ canonical ids where present)
- narrative <= answer_text (truncate to 8k chars if necessary)
- attachments[] <= evidence_url (we'll map to presigned S3 object keys)
- retention_tag <= derive from uploaded_at + Acme retention policy

Technical notes for the canary:
- We'll stand up a temporary presign endpoint that accepts a manifest row and returns a presigned PUT. The client (Acme) will PUT objects to our presign URL and then POST a small ingest payload to the OneTrust ingestion webhook with object keys.
- For the smoke test: 10 artifacts is sufficient to validate claim parsing and retention metadata. If the canary is green we'll schedule the bulk window.

I'll attach a sample crosswalk CSV in the next email but plan to deliver the full mapping by EOD Tue. Also recommend an initial QA window of 48 hours (ingest + manual QA) before final attestation.

- Jonas
Senior Integration Engineer — Redwood Inference
[attachment: sample-crosswalk.csv (text/csv)]

From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmecloud.com>

Neha / team — that schedule works for us. We’ll aim for the 3-hour canary on Wed 2028-03-29 14:00–17:00 PT. A few clarifications:

- We prefer S3 presign (vendor toolchain already supports PUT).
- For the canary we'll send 12 artifacts (mix of PDF and CSV proofs).
- Tom (our compliance lead) asked that the attestation include a short list of the CAIQ questions validated during the canary; Jonas, can you flag those in the crosswalk CSV?

We also need to be explicit about temporary credential rotation post-window — will you rotate keys automatically?

I’ll send our internal upload script and a doc with the artifacts we plan to include.

Thanks,
Alice

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Mar 2028 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr → OneTrust bridge: preflight & upload window

Perfect — thank you for the confirmation, Alice. Finalizing notes and next steps: 

1) Canary window set: Wed 2028-03-29 14:00–17:00 PT (3-hour presigned S3 PUT window).
2) Rotation: keys issued for the window will auto-expire at window close; we’ll rotate the underlying presign key material and revoke any longer-lived tokens. Karthik will run the rotation job and send a rotation manifest to Marissa.
3) Crosswalk: Jonas to attach the flagged CAIQ question ids in the crosswalk CSV (to be included in the attestation).
4) QA/attestation: Marissa will run retention-tag validation and confirm proof possession. If QA is green within 48 hours we’ll issue the attestation via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/attest/ACME-PS-2028).

Marissa — internal note: please stage the evidence retention labels under the "acme-partner" bucket and confirm TTL policy (90 days for canary proofs, then archive per Acme policy).

Alice — we’ll email a short runbook before the window with the presign endpoint, required headers, and a sample PUT flow. Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Neha
Director, Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
